Detailed Description of Event: Worker experienced severe distress after a workplace incident.
Worker stepped into a lower level opening and fell.
Vehicle went over an embankment and stopped on its side.
Worker was hit by a fragment released from a broken disc.
Pressurised hose released and struck a worker.
Worker was caught in moving machinery during operation.
Worker entered a confined area with low oxygen.
Pressure vessel released suddenly during work.
Worker was exposed to low level radiation during inspection.
Incident report did not contain enough detail to identify the energy type.
